item: 20 positions are an adapter sample, not the full 2,348-task population
choice: The adapter reports counts over exactly the 20 frozen positions and never extrapolates accuracy
reason: V22 freezes positions only; full population stays with the central runtime
impact: No accuracy claim can be made from this cell alone

item: Official CypherBench query categories are not present in the frozen public material
choice: category stays null; nothing is inferred from gold
reason: Inferring categories from reference queries would leak the reference side
impact: Category-stratified analysis is unavailable for this sample

item: Scoring is normally the official CypherBench EX implementation
choice: Delegated to runtime.scorer; the adapter stores whatever score it receives
reason: Scoring needs the reference side, which this adapter must not read
impact: A wrong scorer in the runtime would not be detected here

item: Retries and attempt accounting are usually handled by the transport layer
choice: parse accepts attempts and cost; consume sums them; no retry logic in the adapter
reason: The central scheduler owns quota, retries and evidence
impact: Cost is null unless every attempt reports a known cost

item: A 2xx HTTP status can still carry an unusable body
choice: parse classifies the body; non-2xx becomes unknown, never a normal failure
reason: HTTP 200 does not mean a correct answer
impact: Unknown rows stay unknown and remain in the denominator
